text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. It's the glorious first leg
of the Classic Triple Crown—the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course. First,
let us treat the audience
to a greeting in style.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My fans, and my fans-to-be!
Welcome, one and all!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce today's co-star.
Standing in my path is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's Admire Vega, also known as Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Kuuu......

Admire Vega was dragged out
from hiding in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Ayabe-san?
You look so gloomy...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? Could it be that your name
is not Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see... Your name is—"Love"!
Are you saying you are Love itself?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the name of this person is "Love"!!
La la~ la la~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just 'Ayabe-san' is fine...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I told you to leave me alone...
So why are you doing this...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now now, don't say that. We've run alongside each other so many times since then, and we understand each other now, don't we?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I already know everything about you.
Yes, you are... an Umamusume of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And she wants to win the Satsuki Sho!
What in the world...?! No waaaay!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...That concludes what I have learned.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You only understand
the bare minimum baseline, don't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Did you not save
the rest precisely for today?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us head to the track side by side,
my rival!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Agh, what is this...!
I just wanted to focus in peace!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't lose to their interference! I can't afford to!
This race... isn't just for myself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪
Shall we go then?

With magnificent steps, T.M. Opera O
takes the lead ahead of Admire Vega.
"The Legend: Chapter 1"—the curtain rises now!
